name: Trogg
summary: Deep beneath the earth, Troggs have clawed their way into the world above. Dwarven excavations disturbed their ancient vaults, and now they overrun quarries and hold Gnomeregan after driving its gnomes out.

sections.title: The Flawed Predecessors
sections.body: The first stone servants were a flawed design. Long before mortal races kept records, titan-forged keepers tried to shape servants from stone. They made brutish creatures with stone skin, little sense, and savage tempers. The keepers refined their design into the earthen, ancestors of the dwarves. Ironaya, a giantess, spared the flawed troggs and sealed them deep within Uldaman, hoping they would sleep without end.

sections.title: Awakened by the Pickaxe
sections.body: Dwarven excavations woke the troggs after countless millennia. The Explorers' League of Ironforge broke into ancient underground complexes in Khaz Modan, and furious swarms poured out to hunt their distant dwarven kin. The bright surface world drove them to dig tunnels beneath Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and the Badlands. From below, they ambushed quarries, archaeological dig sites, and trade outposts.

sections.title: The Catastrophe at Gnomeregan
sections.body: Troggs followed underground vibrations and noise into Gnomeregan. Outnumbered and overpowered, the gnomes fought them through the city's corridors. Mekgineer Thermaplugg devised a desperate plan. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque released radioactive gas to kill the invaders, but it killed roughly eighty percent of the gnomish people and only enraged the troggs. The great city was left irradiated and under trogg control.

faq.answer: Troggs are underground humanoids, the first flawed stone servants made by the titan-forged keepers. The keepers sealed them in stasis vaults such as Uldaman instead of destroying them. Dwarven miners later unearthed them.
Yes. The titans' keepers shaped both races. Troggs were their crude first design, while the earthen, ancestors of the dwarves, were the refined design.

Troggs followed the vibrations of heavy machinery and tunneled up into Gnomeregan. Their numbers overwhelmed the gnomes despite their defensive inventions. Radioactive gas meant to drive out the invaders killed most of the gnomes, leaving the city in trogg hands.

faq.q: Are troggs capable of speech or advanced culture?
faq.answer: Troggs have little intellect and mostly communicate with grunts and roars. They prize brute strength and choose tribal chieftains through violence. Some show simple shamanistic magic, but their craft remains crude, from clubs and stone arrows to stolen relics.

faq.q: Why do troggs collect ancient relics?
faq.answer: Explorers believe troggs hoard ancient titan relics because of an instinct left from their origins. Troggs rarely understand the objects, using priceless artifacts as clubs or simple charms for luck.

faq.q: Are there troggs outside of Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Yes. Trogg clans live underground across Azeroth, including the Ragefire troggs deep in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, the Gravelflint troggs in Darkshore, and groups in the Badlands and Alterac.

angles.text: Troggs are the bitter bane of your people. They shattered your underground home and scattered the survivors to Tinker Town in Ironforge.
Your people unearthed these savage cousins while seeking titan ancestry. Their incursions across Khaz Modan followed from dwarven archaeology.
Troggs often occupy rich mineral veins and deep mines such as Gol'Bolar. Miners must defend their claims with pickaxes and hammers.
Defending Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and Gnomeregan from trogg infestations helps protect the mountain kingdom and its refugees.
